---
name: Synthetic bug reproduction
about: Report an issue using new invented data and public source references
---

## Expected and observed behavior

Explain the contract and observed difference. Do not attach real records, logs, conversations, configuration, URLs, credentials, receipts, or screenshots of private content.

## New synthetic reproduction

Use temporary files and invented values created for this report. Do not anonymize an actual record. Include a minimal command or test that is independent from your actual library.

## Public version and environment

Specify package/service versions, operating system family and interpreter version. Remove account names, hostnames and personal paths.

## Verification boundary

Describe what was actually checked. Keep engineering test behavior separate from real recall accuracy or user benefit. Security details should use a private vulnerability channel.
